page.meta_title: Hathor (Egyptian mythology) — Character, lore & connections | Ton-o-Lore
page.meta_description: Hathor is lady of turquoise and drunkenness, a solar daughter who can become the Eye of Ra, and a greeter of the dead in Theban tombs. Related pages: Thebes.
page.content:
Cow-goddess of joy, music, and the western necropolis.

How Hathor connects

  • Location: Thebes — Hathor greets the Theban dead on the western mountain.

What is Hathor?

Hathor is lady of turquoise and drunkenness, a solar daughter who can become the Eye of Ra, and a greeter of the dead in Theban tombs.

Key threads lead to Thebes.
